description: Source code for wpa_supplicant ucode integration, managing interface and BSS state updates via a microcontroller environment.

methods.name: wpas_ucode_iface_get_uval
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a ucode resource value for a given wpa_supplicant interface.

methods.name: wpas_ucode_update_interfaces
methods.description: Updates the list of interfaces in the ucode environment.

methods.name: wpas_ucode_add_bss
methods.description: Adds a new BSS interface to the ucode environment.

methods.name: wpas_ucode_free_bss
methods.description: Removes a BSS interface from the ucode environment.

methods.name: wpas_ucode_update_state
methods.description: Updates the state of a wpa_supplicant interface in the ucode environment.

methods.name: wpas_ucode_event
methods.description: Handles events for a wpa_supplicant interface in the ucode environment.

methods.name: uc_wpas_add_iface
methods.description: Creates a new interface in the wpa_supplicant environment via ucode.

methods.name: uc_wpas_remove_iface
methods.description: Removes an interface from the wpa_supplicant environment via ucode.

methods.name: uc_wpas_iface_status
methods.description: Retrieves the status of an interface.

methods.name: uc_wpas_iface_ctrl
methods.description: Sends a control command to an interface.

methods.name: wpas_ucode_init
methods.description: Initializes the ucode environment for wpa_supplicant.

methods.name: wpas_ucode_free
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the ucode environment.
